subtitle: Lesson 39 · Arrays, nested tables & associative arrays

caption: The max size (5) is fixed at declaration and can never grow past it.

eyebrow: Nested Table: unbounded, can be a column type
caption: No fixed max — and can even be used as a real database column type.

eyebrow: Associative Array: indexed by STRING, in-memory only
caption: The one closest to a dictionary/hash map — the most commonly used of the three.
No string-keyed collection variable, no VARRAY-style fixed-size semantics.
